set.body: The atlas adapter constructs a VolumeDomain key from a runtime hashCode, unusable as a persistent/cross-process identity, and the migration from the local parcellation facade to locus4s is incomplete. Both gate Neuropublish ADR 0005 (finite indexed domains; Stage 5b realization adapters): the protocol defines volume-grid/v1 and finite-indexed/v1 preimage digests (see neuropublish/docs/decisions/0005-*.md §1). Acceptance: no persistent key emitted by ScalaFIM depends on JVM/JS hashCode; scalafim-atlas exposes parcel assignments as locus4s PartialSurjection over image4s support identity.
set.title: Persistent VolumeDomain keys and locus4s-backed parcellations in scalafim-atlas
